title: Imiyoborere
subtitle: Amateka y'amategeko y'igerageza, igitabo cy'igenzura, raporo z'uburenganzira n'igerageza ryabwo, n'itunganywa ry'uburenganzira.
tamperNote: Igitabo cy'igenzura cy'igerageza cyerekana uko bikwiye gukora ariko ntikigaragaza ko kidashobora guhindurwa.

offline.title: Nta murandasi (igerageza)
offline.body: Amakuru y'imiyoborere ntashobora kuvugururwa kandi impinduka ntizibikwa kugeza murandasi igarutse.

rulesets.title: Amateka y'amategeko y'igerageza
rulesets.subtitle: Buri verisiyo y'amategeko yo kugaragaza ibisuzumwa, n'umubare w'isuzuma ryakozwe muri ako karere. Hano ntibihindurwa: impinduka zifatwa n'ubuyobozi bw'ubuvuzi.
rulesets.reasonCodes: Kode z'impamvu iyi verisiyo ishobora gutanga
rulesets.thresholdsHidden: Imibare y'imbibi ntigaragazwa: ni ingero gusa, ntabwo ari indangagaciro zemejwe n'abaganga.

changeSummary.initial_placeholders: Ingero za mbere z'igerageza (umuvuduko w'amaraso n'isukari).
changeSummary.placeholders_revised: Ingero zavuguruwe; isukari idafite amakuru yuzuye yoherezwa ku muntu uyisuzuma.

audit.title: Igitabo cy'igenzura
audit.subtitle: Gusoma gusa. Ibishya mbere, 25 kuri paji. Ibijyanye n'umurwayi byerekana nimero zihishe gusa; inyandiko z'ubuvuzi ziguma ku nyandiko.
audit.caption: Ibyabaye byanditswe
audit.emptyHint: Hindura cyangwa ukureho ibyungurura kugira ngo ubone ibindi.

error.entity: Hitamo ubwoko bw'ikintu buri ku rutonde.
error.dateOrder: Itariki itangira igomba kuba mbere cyangwa ingana n'iya nyuma.
error.correlation: Correlation id igizwe n'inyuguti, imibare, utudomo, utubago, uturongo cyangwa utuvuguto gusa.

access.title: Raporo y'uburenganzira
access.countsLabel: Ibyabaye byo kugera ku makuru ku gikorwa
access.noDenials: Nta kwinjira kwanzwe muri iki gihe

sim.title: Igerageza ry'uburenganzira
sim.subtitle: Ese umukoresha w'igerageza ashobora kubona iki kintu? Bikoresha uburyo bumwe bwo gufata icyemezo n'ubugenzura nyakuri.
sim.rule: Itegeko: {{persona}} akora nka {{role}}; ubushobozi busabwa {{permission}}; ububasha buva ku burenganzira bwe.

reason.OK: Byemewe: inshingano ifite ubushobozi kandi ikintu kiri mu burenganzira.
reason.MISSING_CAPABILITY: Byanzwe: inshingano y'uyu mukoresha ntifite ubushobozi busabwa
reason.GRANT_EXPIRED: Byanzwe: uburenganzira bw'uyu mukoresha bwarangiye cyangwa bwakuweho
reason.OUT_OF_SCOPE_DISTRICT: Byanzwe: akarere kari hanze y'ububasha bw'uyu mukoresha
reason.OUT_OF_SCOPE_FACILITY: Byanzwe: ikigo kiri hanze y'ububasha bw'uyu mukoresha

sim.tryItHint: Ihindura isomo ry'igerageza ikajya ku mukoresha wahisemo, igafungura incamake ya District Beta, ukabona paji ya 403 nyakuri n'icyanditswe cyayo.
sim.tryIt: Gerageza nka {{persona}}: fungura incamake ya District Beta
sim.tryItSelf: Uyu ni wowe: District Beta ishobora kuba mu bubasha bwawe.
sim.returnBanner: Guhindura inshingano y'igerageza: urimo kugerageza porogaramu nka {{persona}} (byatangijwe na {{original}}).

roles.title: Uburenganzira bwo kugera ku makuru
roles.subtitle: Ububasha bwa raporo n'inshingano bya buri mukoresha w'igerageza. Uburenganzira ntibusibwa; buri mpinduka ifite verisiyo kandi iranditswe.
roles.readOnly: Gusoma gusa: umuyobozi wa porogaramu (roles.configure) wenyine ni we ushobora guhindura uburenganzira.
roles.historyEmpty: Nta mpinduka zanditswe (cyangwa ntizigaragara mu bubasha bwawe).

conflict.title: Ubu burenganzira bwahinduwe n'undi muntu
conflict.description: Gereranya verisiyo yawe n'iya nyuma, hanyuma ugumane iya nyuma cyangwa usubize impinduka yawe hejuru yayo.

demo.staleArmed: Kubika ubutaha ubu burenganzira bizahura na verisiyo nshya (igerageza).

dialog.title: Hindura uburenganzira — {{persona}}
dialog.description: Impinduka zikurikizwa igihe uwo mukoresha agiye ahandi.
dialog.banner: Igenamiterere ry'inshingano ry'igerageza — si imicungire nyakuri y'uburenganzira
dialog.facilitiesHint: Ibigo by'uturere twatoranyijwe gusa ni byo bishobora gutoranywa.
dialog.validToHint: Si ngombwa. Uyu munsi cyangwa nyuma (itariki ya Kigali).
dialog.notSaved: Ntibyabitswe — ongera ugerageze. Ibyo wanditse biracyahari.
